messages:
Priya M: Quick sync — finalizing pricing page updates before the webinar next Tue. Need decisions on: (1) FAQ wording for committed vs metered, (2) slab calculator UX, (3) inbound lead routing rules. Minimal A/B test plan?

Alex D: Pushed an updated mock to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz. Suggest we try a compact calculator (token slider + monthly commit dropdown) vs a static matrix. Calculator should show 3 scenarios (baseline, 10% discount commit, 20% commit). Keep initial render minimal — lazy-load the heavy JS.

Diego G: Data note — interactive calculators historically lift demo requests ~10–15% but can increase CLS if not careful. Lazy-load sounds necessary. We should also sample a performance cohort without the calc.

Jordan A: Metrics to capture: click_to_demo, pricing_scroll_depth, calc_open, calc_submit, est_monthly_value. Event names: pricing_calc_open, pricing_calc_interact, pricing_calc_submit. I'll add them to tracking doc.

Sam B: FAQ copy suggestion: change phrasing from 'committed' to 'reserving capacity' in consumer-facing copy. Draft line: "Reserved capacity (committed plans) gives predictable throughput and a discounted rate — ideal for consistent production usage." Short + long variants attached.

Lina: For lead routing — we need est_monthly_spend on the lead record. Proposal: tag demo requests from calc with metadata "est_monthly" and "commit_tier". Routing rule: est_monthly >= 5000 -> enterprise queue; else inbound SDR. Also route by region tag first.

Marcos: Analytics checklist: add exp param (exp=pricing_calc_v2) to URLs. GA4 needs a custom metric for est_monthly and an experiment dimension. I'll also add a de-dupe cookie so repeat visits don't skew conversions.

Alex D: UX points: in compact mode show 'estimate only' badge, inline tooltip explaining assumptions (tokens/day, seq len = 512), and a CTA that becomes 'Contact sales' when est >= $1k. Microcopy for tooltip: "Estimates assume 30-day usage and default model pricing; actual billing may vary."

Priya M: Decision proposal: Run an A/B test (Calculator vs Static Table) on the pricing page for organic + paid traffic. Run length: 2 weeks, measure demo requests (primary), click-to-contact and est_to_demo conversion (secondary). Diego, can you add the feature flag?

Diego G: Yep. I'll add a feature flag pricing_calculator_v2 and implement lazy loading. Backend endpoint for server-side sanity checks: POST /api/pricing/estimate payload: {tokens:int, seq_len:int, commit_months:int} response: {est_monthly:string, slab_id:string}. We'll cap sequence len at 2048.

Jordan A: I'll wire events and build a small dashboard: calc_interaction funnel, calc_submit -> demo_request attribution, and per-experiment breakdown. Sam, can you finalize the FAQ variants by EOD?

Sam B: On it — pushing two copy variants here in a sec. Variant A = concise; Variant B = expanded with examples.

Priya M: Lina, confirm SDR routing playbook once you update the flow?

Lina: Confirmed. Flow: demo leads -> ingest -> attach est_monthly -> if est_monthly >= 5000 then route to 'enterprise-ops' and notify @marcos-sales; else route to 'inbound-sdr' channel. Also set lead source = pricing_calc_v2 when experiment is on.

Marcos: I'll map GA4 fields into the CRM and add the experiment id to lead payloads. Will also enable a TTL cookie to avoid double-counting sessions.

Priya M: Great — checklist recap: Sam (copy), Alex (final mock + dev handoff), Diego (flag + endpoint), Jordan (events/dashboard), Lina (routing). Please post ✅ here when done. :thumbsup:
